jobs.occupation: Avionics retrofit systems manager (m/f) (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Job Description:  French Below Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager (f/m) to join our Airbus Services team  based in Toulouse, France.As a "Retrofit Systems Manager", you will be responsible for a given set of avionics products of Upgrades Retrofit Projects to drive the technical definition and execution of the engineering retrofit solution (Service Bulletin).Your role and responsibilities:  - Manage a Retrofit project (on-time, cost and quality) end to end from Technical 0ffer or Service Bulletin (SB) launching decision coming from Service Bulletin control Board (SBCB) to SB technical approval and dispatch to the customers, ensuring technical support when required.- For optional upgrade subjects, perform Technical Offers and contribute to ROM at pre-sales phase, in coordination with Airframe Services (SRx) and Sales.- For aircraft product improvement subjects perform the maturity analysis and decide on the launching of the retrofit solution and planning.- Define the most appropriate retrofit solution technical definition based on customer expectations,- Coordinate and contribute to MOD TRS creation/update/justification with Design Office (MOD new) or internally (MOD CTK - Close To Known),- Support Production Center during SB authoring phase,- Perform optional SB Technical Approval as per DOS delegations (after a period of training),- Answer to customer queries (Tech Request) and support working parties, provide RDAF (Technical Adaptation) if necessary,- Identify and develop new products/retrofit solutions in collaboration with Airframe Services and Design Office.You boarding pass:  - Graduated from an Master in electronic or Aeronautical Engineering diploma- Strong knowledge of aircraft avionics systems (at least one of the following ATA 22, 23, 27, 31, 34, 45, 46)- Aircraft configuration management- Airworthiness and safety- Project management- Aircraft maintenance experience would be a plus- Proactive, good team player and good organizational skills- Good communication skills and customer minded- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvementGood level in French- Fluent in EnglishYour working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.Work / Life Balance:  Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.Take your career to a new level and apply online now!----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Airbus Commercial Aircraft propose un poste d'Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager (f/h) pour rejoindre notre équipe Airbus Services basée à Toulouse, France.En tant que  Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager, vous serez responsable d'un ensemble donné de produits avioniques, de mener des projets de modernisation et de mise à niveau avion, pour cela vous devrez piloter la définition technique et l'exécution de la solution de modernisation technique (Bulletin de service).Votre rôle et vos responsabilités :- Gérer un projet de Retrofit (délais, coût et qualité) dans son intégralité depuis l'offre technique ou la décision de lancement du Service Bulletin (SB) prise en Service Bulletin Control Board (SBCB) jusqu'à l'approbation technique SB et l'expédition au client, ainsi que le support technique sur demande du client.- Pour les modifications optionnelles vous devrez réaliser les offres techniques et contribuer au ROM en phase d'avant-vente, en coordination avec Airframe Services (SRx) et les Sales,- Pour les mises à niveau avion vous devrez effectuer l'analyse de maturité et décider du lancement du service bulletin ainsi que de son planning.- Définir la définition tec

jobs.occupation: Accounting Manager Western Europe (H/F)
jobs.description: At Miele, we work every day on products and services that stand for uncompromising quality. We do this with people who take responsibility, collaborate across borders, and strive for continuous improvement. For our Western Europe cluster, we are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager with excellent people management skills.Alongside your existing skills and experience, we're looking for engaged team players who will collaborate, innovate and use their passion to drive an exceptional customer experience at every touchpoint.If you are the best at what you do and have bold ideas and ambitions for progressing your career with Miele we want to hear from you!What you will be doing:As Accounting Manager, you are responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of financial reporting and projects across the four markets of the cluster: Belgium, Luxemburg, France and the Netherlands. You ensure the quality, reliability and compliance of financial information, while developing a forward-looking perspective for the cluster. You oversee a team of accounting experts and work closely with local teams, regional finance, the international shared service center in Poland, and the global Miele organizationKey responsibilities:Lead and develop a team of five (3 accounting officers and 2 credit controllers).Strengthen capabilities, drive performance, and foster collaboration within the team, with the International Shared Service Center and across departments.Lead the month-end and year-end closing financial processes .Ensure timely, accurate and compliant reporting of financial data (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) in accordance with Miele guidelines and local legislation.Act as the local point of contact for tax, legal and credit management related activities within the cluster.Ensure transfer pricing and intercompany compliance in line with Group policies.Act as Compliance Ambassador, safeguarding accounting integrity and financial governance.Contribute to project design, coordinate central and local stakeholders, and drive harmonization of financial processes across the cluster.Deliver pragmatic, value-driven solutions to operational needs.Why you should choose this job at Miele:At Miele, we are committed to talent, growth and sustainability. We are building a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone gets equal opportunities and can be the best version of themselves. Working from your talent makes you happy and gives you energy and desire to make a difference. Together, we develop innovative solutions that help the company succeed and make life easier for many households.We offer you:A permanent contract.A competitive salary based on your experience and skills.Flexible working hours, combined with remote working (2 days/week), to help you strike a good balance between work and leisure time.Work location: HQ Le Blanc Mesnil, and the tools you need to work to the best of your ability.A strong brand and a stable family business that attaches great importance to customer satisfaction.The Accounting Manager we are looking for:Proven knowledge of accounting, tax and legal matters in an international context.Education in finance and accounting, preferably CFA, CPA, FA or equivalent.5+ years of leadership experience and excellent people management skills.Strong business acumen and a commercial mindset.Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively.Experience working in a multinational, multi-location and multilingual environment.Comfortable operating within a matrix organization with diverse stakeholders.Excellent command of English and French (both written and spoken at C1-level).Professional, meticulous and collaborative communication style.Would you like to join us on a quest for "Immer Besser" and further develop your career? Then apply now!
